evidence_scope: Exploratory development on previously examined T2I and WebVid cohorts.

timing.note: Per-query graph repeat medians; mean ratios. Descriptive quantiles are not service latency percentiles.

t2i.gate_execution: offline static-arm stitching; no gate latency measured

common_support.scope: conditional on both arms attaining physical spend and intended seeded routes; no population extrapolation
common_support.conditional_tail_unit: Pool only supported graph-query events; each policy has its own worst ceil(1%/5%) of that common population. Empty support gives null means and zero counts. These descriptive event-level tails do not assume event independence.
